verdict.rationale: OCI ships an official MCP server (oracle/mcp) which could let AI agents translate natural-language requests into OCI API/CLI calls, and OCI's Select AI Agent Framework shows some agentic tooling, but there is no direct documentation of a natural-language command interface for operating OCI resources (e.g., a chat-driven console or NL-to-CLI translator) — the CLI and SDKs described are purely programmatic/scripted, not NL-driven. missing for 10: documented natural-language command capability for infrastructure operations, first-party examples of NL→action mapping, and independent confirmation of MCP server usage for OCI resource management.
